notes:
Lead: VP Engineering (A. Singh) — strongly focused on low-latency EU/UK search for regulatory content. POC scope: embeddings + reranking pipeline to surface authoritative clauses and precedents.

Key requirements (from calls):
- Indexing scale: 50M - 150M documents (mixed PDF/Word/html), expect steady-state growth 10-15% qtrly. Need shard/partition guidance and cost modeling for 100M+ vectors.
- Latency targets: 95p end-to-end search (embedding lookup + rerank) under 120ms for EU region, prefer <100ms for interactive UX.
- Throughput: 200 queries/sec (average), burst up to 1k qps during peak research windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per user query <= $0.004 (including embedding + rerank inference amortized). CFO will push back if cost > $0.01/q.
- Model preferences: open LLMs for rerank (e.g., Llama variants quantized) + in-house embedding model fine-tune. Want option to pin model versions and fallback to smaller quantized variants.
- Residency: Data-at-rest and processing must be within EU/UK boundaries. Primary region EU-West (Ireland) with hot-failover to Frankfurt and a UK node for UK-only datasets.
- Security ops: SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1y, KMS keys per-tenant, DPA + Article 28 clarity.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (ff_20260115_7890). Covered use-case + rough scale. AE: M. Patel. SE review requested.
- 2026-02-03: Technical deep-dive with infra + data team. Discussed sharding, KV cache strategies, batching tradeoffs. Action: SE to prototype latency calc.
- 2026-02-10: Security sync (ff_20260210_4432). Raised KMS & audit questions; provided SOC2 + penetration test summary.
- 2026-02-25: Demo request submitted; customer asked for a rerank-first flow and tokenized cost split.
- 2026-03-01: Pricing + SOW draft sent (drive://greengate/POC-architecture.pdf). Waiting legal review.

POC plan (next 6 weeks):
- Week 1: Deploy dedicated VPC test env in EU-West; ingest 5M doc sample, run indexing pipeline.
- Week 2: Baseline embedding latency and retrieval throughput; measure 95p latencies.
- Week 3: Integrate reranker model, measure end-to-end latencies; tune batching/kv cache.
- Week 4: Failover test to Frankfurt + UK node; validate residency controls & routing policies.
- Deliverable: perf report + cost-per-query model and recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
